column1: # Point-in-time NIFTY 50 membership. THIS FILE IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY.
# It ships with no data rows on purpose. The engine fails closed: with this
# file empty
column2: `assert_backtest_ready()` raises and no backtest can start.

column1: # The alternative — shipping today's fifty names with open-ended start dates —
# would look helpful and would silently reintroduce survivorship bias into
# every result the project ever produces. A basket selected *because* it
# survived hands the strategy foreknowledge of which companies did not blow
# up. That is the single most common reason a retail Indian equity backtest
# looks good and is worthless
column2: and it is the exact failure this file exists to

column1: # prevent. So: no plausible-looking placeholder data. Populate it or don't
# backtest.
# WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM
#   No broker API serves historical index membership — not Kite
#   not any of the free tiers. Sources
#     1. NSE Indices reconstitution press releases (the citable source).
#        https://www.niftyindices.com  ->  Media / Press Releases.
#        Published ~4 weeks before each semi-annual change takes effect.
#        Changes are effective from the LAST TRADING DAY of March and
#        September (the new list trades from the next session).
#     2. NSE Indices factsheets / index methodology archives.
#     3. A paid vendor point-in-time constituents feed.
#   Roughly 4-8 changes per year over 2019-2026
column2: so this is a couple of hours

#   provenance   nse_circular | vendor | seed
#                  nse_circular / vendor  -> trusted; backtests may run
#                  seed                   -> recalled/unverified; BLOCKS backtests
